steps.expr: (() => { const svg=document.querySelector('svg'); if(!svg) return JSON.stringify({ok:false,why:'no svg',title:document.title}); const gi=[...svg.querySelectorAll('image')].find(i=>i.getAttribute('width')==='33'); const gb=gi?gi.getBBox():null; const crest=[...svg.querySelectorAll('image')].find(i=>i.getAttribute('width')==='69.3'); const cb=crest?crest.getBBox():null; const arcs=[...svg.querySelectorAll('path')].filter(p=>Math.abs(p.getTotalLength()-339.29)<3); const rb=arcs.length?arcs[0].getBBox():null; const ticks=[...svg.querySelectorAll('line')].filter(l=>Math.abs(l.getTotalLength?-1:1)>=0).length; return JSON.stringify({ok:true, glyphBbox: gb?{x:+gb.x.toFixed(1),y:+gb.y.toFixed(1),w:+gb.width.toFixed(1),h:+gb.height.toFixed(1)}:null, crestBbox: cb?{x:+cb.x.toFixed(1),y:+cb.y.toFixed(1),w:+cb.width.toFixed(1)}:null, rearArcFound: arcs.length, rearArcBbox: rb?{x:+rb.x.toFixed(1),y:+rb.y.toFixed(1),w:+rb.width.toFixed(1),h:+rb.height.toFixed(1)}:null}); })()
